messages:
Nina Ortega: quick idea  run a compact launch for DevFlow refkit + three short tutorials. goal: fast dev onboarding + measurable bench wins. :sparkles:
Sam Patel: love it. scope? one deep dive or three micro tutorials?
Nina Ortega: three micro tutorials: quickstart, cost/latency tuning, and production checklist. single refapp repo demonstrates routing + cache. short blog to tie everything together.
Jules Rivera: i'll draft quickstart + prod checklist. Sam, want the bench narrative?
Sam Patel: yes. i'll do bench write-up comparing xr-small quantized vs baseline. keep it reproducible & lightweight (3 runs, median). include commands e.g.:
```
python run_microbench.py --model xr-small --seq 256 --runs 3 --seed 42
```
Kai M.: I'll scaffold the refapp with two flows: hosted -> local fallback. small Dockerfile + quickstart script. pushing branch by Thu.
ContentBot: Reminder: add utm_source=devflow&utm_campaign=refkit_launch to all links.
Nina Ortega: inbound flow: blog CTA should create HubSpot list `devflow_refkit` and tag leads `refkit_launch`. nurture drip: how-to, bench tips, invite to office hours.
Jules Rivera: social assets needed: 1 hero image, 2 short GIFs (hosted flow, local fallback), and three tweet-sized captions.
Sam Patel: deliverables: bench CSVs, a bench/readme.md with metrics & event names, and a reproducibility checklist. i'll post results Mon morning.
Kai M.: repo layout: `/tutorials/01-quickstart`, `/tutorials/02-cost`, `/tutorials/03-prod-checklist`, `/refapp/` with `docker/` and `deploy.md`.
Nina Ortega: timeline: drafts by Fri EOD, bench artifacts Mon, blog + socials Mon, webinar page Tue, launch Wed. everyone good?
Jules Rivera: tight but doable. will prioritize copy.
Sam Patel: fine. will run CI bench tonight and share raw CSVs.
Kai M.: branch pushed -> pinged in #devrel.
ContentBot: Action created: content/launch/devflow-refkit checklist (owner: Nina).
Nina Ortega: final asks: ensure all code blocks are copy-paste ready and include a minimal env var example (API_KEY only). small friction points kill adoption.
Jules Rivera: noted. quickstart will be a single-file example with env var defaults.
Sam Patel: will avoid bold claims; any "2x cost reduction" headline must be backed by the bench CSV.
Nina Ortega: i'll convert this to Notion checklist and assign tasks. will follow up with calendar invite once blog date is locked. thanks team! :thumbsup:
